e8b_deferred_cleanup.purpose: Non-blocking findings from the certification reviews of 2026-08-08 that were NOT remediated in the targeted pass, recorded so they cannot silently disappear. None of them reopens scientific readiness.
e8b_deferred_cleanup.gating_rule: an item belongs here only if it does NOT affect execution correctness, scientific validity, active resource policy, result provenance or the clean-test embargo. Anything that does is remediated immediately, not deferred.

items.finding: Four E8A generators were pointed at the authoritative ceiling constant, but their published records were deliberately not regenerated. efficiency_resources.json still holds ceiling 35.0 / margin 29.21073 where its generator would now emit 40.0 / 34.21073; resource_correction_g21.json holds 35-derived margins; stage8_projection.json keeps the old per_model_35_hours key; three_way_comparison.json keeps the old prose. No test asserts E8A record reproduction, so the divergence is silent.
items.reason_non_blocking: does not affect execution correctness, scientific validity, active resource policy, result provenance or the clean-test embargo. These are DATED E8A evidence records for completed work, preserved deliberately under the user's instruction that historical records not be rewritten. Every one is listed and hash-pinned in the supersession manifest, so the divergence is now disclosed rather than silent, and no live gate reads them: all four gates read config.
items.intended_cleanup_point: post-E8B, when the E8A records are next regenerated for the dissertation write-up. Regenerating them now would restate completed measurements under a ceiling that did not exist when they were made.

items.finding: The supersession manifest reported numeric_35_ceiling_fields: [] for resource_correction_g21.json, omitting three 35-derived margin_hours values, contrary to the manifest's own scan rule which counts keys naming a margin.
items.reason_non_blocking: does not affect execution correctness, scientific validity, active resource policy, result provenance or the clean-test embargo. The manifest is now GENERATED and the field is computed by one published rule; the record is listed either way, so membership and hash-pinning are unaffected. Only the itemised field list is incomplete, and margins are derived values, not declared ceilings.
items.intended_cleanup_point: alongside DEFER-1, when the E8A records are regenerated

items.finding: The derivation guard checks value equality plus an assignment-line regex, weaker than its comment claims; the sweep's known-negative exercises the regex rather than the file walk.
items.reason_non_blocking: does not affect execution correctness, scientific validity, active resource policy, result provenance or the clean-test embargo. Derivation itself was proved independently by the certification review with a sentinel probe: all four gates tracked a monkeypatched config value, so the property holds at HEAD. Only the in-suite proof of it is weaker than stated.
items.intended_cleanup_point: post-E8B test hardening; replace the equality check with a sentinel-import probe of the kind the reviewer used

items.finding: The sweep's MARKER word list (prior, earlier, once, continuity, at the time) within 400/900 characters is a weak tense discriminator and could exempt a real claim sitting near unrelated historical prose.
items.reason_non_blocking: does not affect execution correctness, scientific validity, active resource policy, result provenance or the clean-test embargo. No live false negative exists at HEAD: every exempted occurrence was classified by hand in this pass. The guard is a regression backstop, and its documented scope now says so explicitly rather than claiming semantic completeness.
items.intended_cleanup_point: post-E8B, if the guard ever exempts something it should not

items.finding: resource_correction_g21.py's docstring hard-names '40 GPU-hours', and run.py's retry fire_reason strings hard-type 'over the 40 h ceiling', rather than interpolating the constant.
items.reason_non_blocking: does not affect execution correctness, scientific validity, active resource policy, result provenance or the clean-test embargo. Both are correct at HEAD and neither is read by a gate; they are prose. They are the same literal-duplication class the amendment removed from executable paths, which is why they are recorded rather than dismissed.
items.intended_cleanup_point: post-E8B, in the same pass as DEFER-3

items.finding: efficiency_resources.PER_RUN_CEILING_HOURS derives from e8a_common.WALL_CLOCK_HALT_HOURS rather than config.PER_RUN_WALL_CLOCK_HOURS. Same value (8.0), two sources.
items.reason_non_blocking: does not affect execution correctness, scientific validity, active resource policy, result provenance or the clean-test embargo. The per-run wall was NOT amended, so there is no conflict to resolve; both sources agree and always have. Recorded because two sources for one governed quantity is exactly the shape of the defect that caused this whole sequence.
items.intended_cleanup_point: post-E8B; fold e8a_common's copy into config the way the ceiling was

items.finding: identity_reconciliation.py embeds a literal newline and 13 spaces inside a string emitted to JSON.
items.reason_non_blocking: does not affect execution correctness, scientific validity, active resource policy, result provenance or the clean-test embargo. Cosmetic; the field is emitted on the halt path only, which is not currently reachable.

items.finding: A commit message stated 49 claim-form occurrences where the measured figure with that pattern was 48.
items.reason_non_blocking: does not affect execution correctness, scientific validity, active resource policy, result provenance or the clean-test embargo. A commit message is immutable history and is corrected by the record, not by rewriting it. The live count is now emitted by the guard itself on every run.
